title: Workable Pricing
notes: Verified 2026-08-18 from workable.com/pricing (high confidence for 1–20 employee annual band). Standard $299/mo ($3,588/yr); Premier $599; Enterprise $719. Higher headcount bands require quote. Affiliate economics excluded.
